meta.name: context-manager
meta.description: Teaches you how to break large tasks into stages, save your place between sessions, and recover smoothly when a task gets interrupted. Use when planning a multi-day project, for breaking down large work into manageable stages, during recovery from an interrupted session, when managing complex ongoing work, or when the user says "cowork stopped in the middle", "token limit", "task too large", "context management", "how to do big tasks", "session got cut off", "cowork forgot what we were doing", "how do I work on something over multiple days", "it lost track of the project", or "my task is too big for one session".

copy.tagline: 把大任务拆成阶段，跨会话恢复进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理跨多天的复杂任务，需要管理上下文和进度
copy.tagline_en: Break large tasks into stages and resume across sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle complex multi-day tasks and need to manage context and progress
